macos.notes: macOS 26.5.2 arm64 proved a full-host AppKit backing view below a transparent Tauri webview, physical viewport clipping, deterministic absence outside the clip, renderer-forwarded input admission, zero collapse and restore, visibility and injected host-focus gates, host resize, stale-state invariance, destroy ordering, and reversible detach. The one-monitor host exposed only 2x scale, so a native scale transition remains unmet and unsimulated. Separate pure 1x/2x conversion fixtures pass.

windows.notes: This private proof implements only the AppKit backing-view path. A Windows child HWND or compositor mechanism has not been selected or packaged.

linux.notes: This private proof implements only the AppKit backing-view path. A Linux GTK/WebKitGTK subsurface mechanism has not been selected or packaged.
